page.overview:
Who is 009?

009 was the code-name of an unnamed intelligence operative of the Double-O Section, an ultra-covert unit within the Secret Intelligence Service (SIS/MI6). The character appeared in Semic Press' 1986 comic book story Dödlig Dubbelgångare (Deadly Double) in Issue #7 of James Bond, Agent 007.
